title.narrative: Strengthening law enforcement capacity of Rwanda Development Board within Nyungwe National Park

description.narrative: The purpose of this project is to support a conservation effort in Nyungwe National Park in Rwanda by strengthening law enforcement operations to ensure long-term protections. This project is intended to conserve eastern chimpanzees and their habitat by addressing the impacts of illegal activities such as snare hunting, mining, and bamboo harvesting. Specific activities include: (1) trainings on patrol techniques and organization, investigation and reporting on wildlife crimes; (2) mixed community patrols to increase the patrol coverage and effectiveness of law enforcement activities; (3) establishment of a mobile camp site in the chimpanzees home range; (4) refresher training for rangers in data collection and for zone leaders in data analysis and reporting; (5) establishment of a regular and timely system of patrol using ranger-based monitoring data; (6) field visits with law enforcement agencies and media to publicize the threats to the park; (7) biannual meetings with law enforcement agencies to discuss key threats and potential mitigation measures; (8) joint patrols with security forces in highly threatened areas; (9) development and monitoring of an effective intelligence-gathering network and guidelines; and (10) selection and training of agents for the intelligence gathering system.
